subject: MAP & evaluation onramp — SE/ML intro and timeline alignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation onramp — SE/ML intro and timeline alignment

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) on paper and introduce the two Redwood engineers who will run the technical evaluation with you. The goal is to get a focused evaluation plan in place so you have a clear go/no-go decision by the end of June.

High-level MAP (draft attached):
- Week 0 (this week): Align scope, stakeholders, and access.
- Week 1: Sandbox access & smoke tests; baseline metrics collection.
- Weeks 2–3: Workload evaluation / stress runs and quality checks vs your prompts.
- Week 4: Consolidate results; remediation if needed.
- Week 6: Final review & decision meeting (target date: 2026-06-25).

Internal introductions (cc'd):
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions Engineer (will lead integration, sandbox endpoints, perf tuning)
- Monica Patel — ML Engineer (will own evaluation metrics, model selection, and quality thresholds)

Asks for you to confirm:
1) Primary technical contact at MapSys (name/email) — who should Karthik work with for access?
2) Any data constraints (VPC/on-prem, PII restrictions) we should know about before we provision anything.
3) Your preferred decision date (we suggested 2026-06-25 above).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf, eval-checklist.xlsx. I also linked a working doc for the MAP.

If that looks good I'll have Karthik and Monica set up a short technical sync — 30 minutes — to kick things off.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation onramp — SE/ML intro and timeline alignment

Hi Alyssa —

Quick intro from my side — I lead Solutions for the account at Redwood. Short summary of the technical plan I propose for Week 1–3: 
- Provision a sandbox tenant (isolated) and a short-lived API key; we'll also provide a docker-based local runtime if you prefer on-prem validation.
- We recommend starting with the redwood-3b-quant model for latency/cost balance; Monica and I can experiment with a larger variant if quality requires it.
- Please share a representative set of 50–200 prompts (both chat and single-turn) and an example payload schema; knowing avg tokens / longest context helps us set batch sizes.
- We'll run a perf sweep: 95th p50/p95 latency, throughput at target RPS, and token cost estimates. Monica will run quality evals (ROUGE/BLEU + human-annotated gold set) and surface failure modes.

Questions for MapSys technical team:
- Do you have a dev/staging VPC we can peer with, or should we proceed with sandbox + sample uploads?
- Are there any IP/PII rules for the test prompts (strip PII, synthetic-only, etc.)?

I attached a short playbook (eval-playbook.md) to this thread and will share runbooks in the shared doc. Available for a 30-minute technical sync tomorrow between 10:00–12:00 PT.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation onramp — SE/ML intro and timeline alignment

Hi Vivek / team —

Thanks for the clear plan and intros. A few quick notes from MapSys side:
- Myself (Product Lead) will own the evaluation and partner with Carlos (cc'd) as Engineering Lead for provisioning and infra work.
- We cannot allow any production customer PII into a third-party sandbox. We'll provide a synthetic dataset and a redacted sample of recent prompts.
- We prefer VPC peering for performance tests; Carlos will follow up on CDK network details.
- Decision timeline: target internal sign-off by 2026-06-25 (matches your proposal). Procurement needs SOC 2 summary and a brief data-retention appendix — can you send those?

I'm available for the technical sync Monday 05/18 10:30–11:00 PT or Tuesday 05/19 09:00–10:00 PT.

Attachments: mapsys-internal-requirements.xlsx

Thanks,
Alyssa Dunn
